div.head: III As 7
div.ab: Septimum: ut omnis homo teneat homines suos in fideiussione sua contra omne furtum.
Septimum, ut omnis homo teneat homines suos in fideiussione sua contra omne furtum.
Seventhly, every man shall stand surety for his own men against every [charge of] crime.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Bürgschaft 3f. Das Or. bot laut homines wohl men, obwohl es schwerlich die Besitzer von Leiheland, die auch anders gerichtlich leicht fassbar waren, mitmeinte
Cf. Gl Bürgschaft 3f. Judging by homines, the orig. probably had men, although it hardly meant to include the holders of leased land, who could easily be brought to court in other ways too
Cf. III Edm. cap. 7; I Athlr. cap. 1; II Can. cap. 31; I Wm. cap. 52; Henr. cap. 8 § 3.
